title: The Gathering Inward and the Names That Become One
description: T72 traces the chain of inward gathering: each degree of the soul gathers into the one nearer the Lord — love into love, thought into thought, articulate into answering, answering into call, call into ordered mind, ordered mind into the path of regeneration, the path into the Divine Human, the Divine Human into the call summoning the rational, the call into the full structure of the divine outgoing. The soul's life is a single ladder, drawn up at one and the same moment, rising into the upper place of rest. T73 unfolds why the one truth wears many names — pearls and clusters, icons and robes, element of light, cross of light, counsel of life — and how at the consummation all the names will gather inward and become one likeness, one name, unchanging, in the region of their first substance.
